006package dev.metaschema.core.metapath.type;
007
008import java.util.Objects;
009
010import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.item.IItem;
011import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.item.ISequence;
012import edu.umd.cs.findbugs.annotations.NonNull;
013
014/**
015 * Identifies the occurrence of a sequence used a function argument or return
016 * value.
017 */
018public enum Occurrence {
019  /**
020   * An empty sequence.
021   */
022  ZERO("", true, Occurrence::handleZero),
023  /**
024   * The occurrence indicator {@code "?"}.
025   */
026  ZERO_OR_ONE("?", true, Occurrence::handleZeroOrOne),
027  /**
028   * No occurrence indicator.
029   */
030  ONE("", false, Occurrence::handleOne),
031  /**
032   * The occurrence indicator {@code "*"}.
033   */
034  ZERO_OR_MORE("*", true, Occurrence::handleZeroOrMore),
035  /**
036   * The occurrence indicator {@code "+"}.
037   */
038  ONE_OR_MORE("+", false, Occurrence::handleOneOrMore);
039
040  @NonNull
041  private final String indicator;
042  private final boolean optional;
043  @NonNull
044  private final ISequenceHandler sequenceHandler;
045
046  Occurrence(@NonNull String indicator, boolean optional, @NonNull ISequenceHandler sequenceHandler) {
047    Objects.requireNonNull(indicator, "indicator");
048    this.indicator = indicator;
049    this.optional = optional;
050    this.sequenceHandler = sequenceHandler;
051  }
052
053  /**
054   * Get the occurrence indicator to use in the signature string for the argument.
055   *
056   * @return the occurrence indicator
057   */
058  @NonNull
059  public String getIndicator() {
060    return indicator;
061  }
062
063  /**
064   * Determine if providing a value is optional based on the occurrence.
065   *
066   * @return {@code true} if providing a value is optional or {@code false} if
067   *         required
068   */
069  public boolean isOptional() {
070    return optional;
071  }
072
073  /**
074   * Get the handler used to check that a sequence meets the occurrence
075   * requirement.
076   *
077   * @return the handler
078   */
079  @NonNull
080  public ISequenceHandler getSequenceHandler() {
081    return sequenceHandler;
082  }
083
084  @NonNull
085  private static <T extends IItem> ISequence<T> handleZero(@NonNull ISequence<T> sequence) {
086    int size = sequence.size();
087    if (size != 0) {
088      throw new InvalidTypeMetapathException(
089          null,
090          String.format("an empty sequence expected, but size is '%d'", size));
091    }
092    return ISequence.empty();
093  }
094
095  @NonNull
096  private static <T extends IItem> ISequence<T> handleOne(@NonNull ISequence<T> sequence) {
097    int size = sequence.size();
098    if (size != 1) {
099      throw new InvalidTypeMetapathException(
100          null,
101          String.format("a sequence of one expected, but size is '%d'", size));
102    }
103
104    T item = sequence.getFirstItem(true);
105    return item == null ? ISequence.empty() : ISequence.of(item);
106  }
107
108  @NonNull
109  private static <T extends IItem> ISequence<T> handleZeroOrOne(@NonNull ISequence<T> sequence) {
110    int size = sequence.size();
111    if (size > 1) {
112      throw new InvalidTypeMetapathException(
113          null,
114          String.format("a sequence of zero or one expected, but size is '%d'", size));
115    }
116
117    T item = sequence.getFirstItem(false);
118    return item == null ? ISequence.empty() : ISequence.of(item);
119  }
120
121  @NonNull
122  private static <T extends IItem> ISequence<T> handleZeroOrMore(@NonNull ISequence<T> sequence) {
123    return sequence;
124  }
125
126  @NonNull
127  private static <T extends IItem> ISequence<T> handleOneOrMore(@NonNull ISequence<T> sequence) {
128    int size = sequence.size();
129    if (size < 1) {
130      throw new InvalidTypeMetapathException(
131          null,
132          String.format("a sequence of one or more expected, but size is '%d'", size));
133    }
134    return sequence;
135  }
136
137  /**
138   * Used to check that a provided sequence matches an associated occurrence
139   * value.
140   */
141  @FunctionalInterface
142  public interface ISequenceHandler {
143    /**
144     * Check that the provided sequence matches the occurrence.
145     * <p>
146     * This method may return a new sequence that more efficiently addresses the
147     * occurrence.
148     *
149     * @param <T>
150     *          the sequence item Java type
151     * @param sequence
152     *          the sequence to check occurrence for
153     * @return the sequence
154     * @throws InvalidTypeMetapathException
155     *           if the sequence doesn't match the required occurrence
156     */
157    @NonNull
158    <T extends IItem> ISequence<T> handle(@NonNull ISequence<T> sequence);
159  }
160}
